1–2 hours (if you already have the items) + 2 h waiting for the helmet

The {wiki:Knight Outfits|Knight Outfit} can be used by any player; this quest gives both addons. The sword is forged by {npc:Morgan}, in Sabrehaven, in exchange for iron ore. The ornate helmet is awarded by {npc:Gregor}, leader of the knights' guild in Thais, after you prove your worth with four tasks; {npc:Sam} finishes the helmet. You also earn the achievement **In Shining Armor**.
